title: [finding][spec] Nine flat "rewrite existing sources automatically" sites remain across three published CHANGELOGs — outside #9734's line-specific authorization
body:
Filed unassigned, observation class, while implementing #9734. Deliberately **not** edited there: the 2026-08-22 maintainer ruling on #9734 authorized exactly one line and closed with "**no blanket sweep**".

## Why this is recorded rather than fixed

#9734 corrected one shipped false claim in `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` under an explicit, **card- and line-specific** maintainer authorization to edit a published release artifact. Editing a published CHANGELOG is otherwise not something a dispatched agent does on its own judgment — that is precisely why #9734 sat in `needs-user-decision` for a day before the ruling.

The census below is the rest of the same defect class. It needs the same kind of decision, not the same PR.

Precedent worth reading first: **#11100** recorded an equivalent CHANGELOG-history defect explicitly "so nobody 'fixes' append-only history". "Leave it, recorded" is a fully respectable outcome here.

## Census (measured on `origin/main` @ `353f4e8f`, after #9734's one-line fix)

⚠️ **The hits are three different things and a search-and-replace would damage two of them.** This is the trap the #9734 thread hit twice.

### Defect class — flat prescriptions stating the false claim (9 sites)

| File | Lines |
|:---|:---|
| `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` | 5306, 8539, 51610, 51666, 52914 |
| `packages/platform-objects/CHANGELOG.md` | 2564, 5589 |
| `examples/app-todo/CHANGELOG.md` | 254, 2384 |

Each reads, flat and in the present tense: ``Run `os migrate meta --from 16` to rewrite existing sources automatically.`` The command has never rewritten an authored source file (#9529); there is no `--write` / `--fix` flag. `os migrate meta --write` is filed for v18 as #9591 and is `pm:on-hold` — so the claim is not merely stale wording, it describes a capability that does not exist yet.

Note `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md:51610` is the **`17.0.0-rc.2` copy of the very entry #9734 corrected** (`ad047d2`, the app-area fail-open gates retirement). The GA copy and the rc copy diverged long ago — the rc copy already carries its own `> **Correction (#5809):**` blockquote — so after #9734 the two copies now disagree about the migrate sentence as well.

### ⛔ NOT defects — quoted in order to retract (do not touch)

- `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md:3791` — #9529's own entry, quoting the withdrawn sentence to retract it; the next line reads "The command has never rewritten an authored source file."
- `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md:5009` — the correction blockquote #9734 just added, same shape.
- `packages/lint/CHANGELOG.md:727` — #9529's entry replicated into lint's changelog.

### ⛔ NOT defects — descriptive, quoting the sentence as evidence

- `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md`: 33399, 37221, 37263, 44922, 45840, 45857 — the `08863dd` / `ecc9110` entries describing the #6856 house-sentence sweep, where the sentence is the subject being described.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/config.ts:133` — explicitly protected by the #9734 ruling.

## The options, if a decision is wanted

- **A — leave it, recorded.** Published changelogs are append-only history; readers of a 17.0.0 entry are reading what shipped. The retractions at `:3791` / `:5009` and lint `:727` are the mitigation. Zero risk. This is #11100's disposition.
- **B — correct the `packages/spec` rc/GA divergence only** (5306, 8539, 51610, 51666, 52914), same one-line-plus-inline-note form #9734 used, leaving the other two packages alone. Narrower than a sweep; fixes the one place where the same file now contradicts itself.
- **C — correct all nine** across the three files, same form.

Any of B/C needs the same explicit maintainer authorization #9734 got. ⛔ None of them is a regex sweep — the "not defects" lists above must be excluded by hand, and site-by-site the correct replacement is the house sentence ``Run `os migrate meta --from 16` to list the mechanical edits for existing sources; apply them by hand.``
